note: Banned and Restricted announcements. Each entry with an 'effective' date and a matching 'format' resets the analysis window for that format, the same way a set release does. mtg_era.py takes whichever is later. Add a new entry after every B&R announcement that touches a format you track. Announcements that change nothing for your format do not need an entry.

announcements.label: post-ban
announcements.note: Three bans aimed at format speed. Badgermole Cub had been format-defining since release and anchored every green shell; Stormchaser's Talent was the Izzet Prowess keystone; Gran-Gran was the Jeskai Lessons mana engine. Every archetype built on those three is dead or rebuilding, so pre-2026-08-10 win rates do not carry forward.
